events.name: Vegas Golden Knights at Pittsburgh Penguins

headlines.description: — Bryan Rust, Ben Kindel and Justin Brazeau each had a goal and an assist, helping the Pittsburgh Penguins beat the Vegas Golden Knights 5-0 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rust and Kindel help the Penguins beat the Golden Knights 5-0

headlines.description: — Teuvo Teravainen scored twice, Arvid Soderblom made 22 saves for his first NHL shutout and the Chicago Blackhawks beat the Utah Mammoth 4-0 on Sunday to end a three-game losing streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Teravainen scores twice, Soderblom makes 22 saves in Blackhawks' 4-0 win over Mammoth

events.name: Winnipeg Jets at San Jose Sharks

headlines.description: — Michael Misa scored 1:40 into overtime, and the San Jose Sharks topped the Winnipeg Jets 2-1 on Sunday for their second straight win.
headlines.shortLinkText: Michael Misa scores in overtime as the San Jose Sharks beat the Winnipeg Jets 2-1

events.name: St. Louis Blues at Minnesota Wild

headlines.description: — Pavel Buchnevich scored late in the third period and the St. Louis Blues snapped a 10-game road losing streak by beating the Minnesota Wild 3-1 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Buchnevich scores late in third period to help Blues end 10-game road skid with 3-1 win over Wild

events.name: Florida Panthers at New York Islanders

headlines.description: — Cutter Gauthier scored twice in regulation, Leo Carlsson and Mason McTavish both converted in the shootout, and the Anaheim Ducks beat the Calgary Flames 3-2 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Gauthier scores 2 goals and Ducks edge Flames 3-2 in shootout for 8th straight home win
